name: STARBOX COFFEE: Coffee Rising
description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. Climb the same spiralling glass-mug cafe with Milo or Mira. Biscuits crack, crumble and reform; permanent timber detours offer a safer route. Collect Espresso or Latte recipes, outrun living coffee and earn Perfect Coffee cards. Free arcade play.
